description:
Screen a person, company, vessel or aircraft name against the primary names and
aliases on the sanctions lists with name coverage (OFAC SDN and Consolidated, UN
Security Council, EU, UK, Swiss SECO, Canada, Australia DFAT, New Zealand, French Trésor, Japan MOF)
and on the US export-control and debarment lists (`us_csl`: BIS Entity List, Denied
Persons, Unverified, Military End User; ITAR Debarred; State nonproliferation
sanctions), whose matches set `flagged`, never `sanctioned`, and carry no party type.
It also checks FinCEN's special measures (`us_fincen_special_measures`: institutions of
primary money laundering concern under Section 311 and related statutes), flagged, never
sanctioned; `metadata.status` is `final` or `proposed`.
Fuzzy, order- and accent-insensitive; each match has a 0-100 `score` and `reasons`.
`type` restricts to one party type. `birth_date` (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD)
excludes listed individuals whose birth dates all disagree; `country` (ISO code or
name) ranks matches by listed nationality/address/flag; `id_number` (passport, national
ID or registration number) ranks a party listing that document first. `threshold`: minimum score
(50-100, default 85). `lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs. `limit`: maximum
matches (1-25, default 10). `ref`: optional reference of your own, echoed and recorded
on the audit trail.
name: screen_name
title: Screen a name
